d: Balwinder Singh Rangila, a well known and renowned raagi of Chandigarh; music is the very essence of life. He was always accompanied in kirtan by his younger brothers Bhai Bhupinder Singh and Bhai Surinder Singh. When he was asked by his father to use his talent to spread the message of love and peace through Gurmat sangeet at the age of seven, nothing could have refrained him from doing so, not even 20 years of hardship and poverty which he faced throughout the prime of his life.
